tests.name: R86 'Check my account' is a run that makes nothing that stays: /begin takes mode check (slug validated, R2's scopes), the callback draws the list for the account it read, clears its cookie, takes no lock, registers no prefix, makes no bucket, and its only write is the plan probe's upload and delete; a probe it cannot delete is named; control: an install and an update answer as before

R87 the list draws every line at once, in CHECK_LINES' fixed order, each ready, not ready or unknown with its own fix: a free plan with a taken name and the limits reached draws them not ready in one run; a failing Containers read is unknown and the rest stand; a ready account draws five ready; a line answering permission asks for approval again; control: the install's own stops answer as before

R88 the card line is derived from the plan line and one storage read: free plan, not ready with the plan's fix; paid with R2 not entitled, the storage fix; paid with R2 on, ready and saying the plan's probe is the only write; paid with R2 unknown, unknown; control: no create call in any of the four

R89 'Check again' re-runs the check from the start with the choices kept, offered with every list; a run depends on no earlier one; a 429 that never mends on one read draws that line unknown with try-again-in-a-minute and the rest as they are; control: a ready account's repeated runs all draw ready

R90 Install now opens only on a passed check: a passed check sets chk (slug and instant only, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, 30 minutes); install /begin with none, an expired one or another slug's is refused CHECK_NOT_PASSED and creates nothing; with it, it proceeds; update and removal need none; R84 stopping what the check passed says it is rare; control: the cookie's decoded bytes

R91 Get ready is R85's guide with Cloudflare's pages as buttons: each of the first three steps opens its page from GET_READY_LINKS in a new tab with what the founder will see there; the last ends with check your account; the first page's act begins a check; no field asks for a token or an id; the page makes no outbound call; control: the update page draws no Get-ready

R92 every link is data in one place: every cloudflare.com address a served page draws comes from GET_READY_LINKS or FIX_LINKS; every CHECK_LINES id has an entry for not_ready and unknown, and a ready line none; ui.mjs and guide.mjs hold no Cloudflare page of their own; control: the tables' URLs are what the pages draw

R93 words by key: every key the list, the gate and CHECK_NOT_PASSED read resolves and is in the installer's KEYS; the drawn list holds no sentence of English beside the keys' words; control: the update page is unchanged by the check
